description: Self-hosted shared memory, knowledge and code intelligence for AI agents on ClickHouse, served over MCP, HTTP and the Python (clickhouse-loom) and TypeScript (@clickhouse/loom) SDKs.
rules: Every operation is one HTTP endpoint, POST /v1/<operation>. Most are also MCP tools at <server>/mcp, named loom_ plus the operation name with dots as underscores (memory.set is loom_memory_set).
A call carries a JWT whose org and namespaces scope what it can read and write; only a single-user server on the same machine accepts calls without one.
A memory is one claim stored under a readable key in a namespace: write it with memory.set and find it with memory.search.
Use the code.* operations for questions about an indexed repository instead of reading whole files.
